streamOpcodes: The relay DOES NOT implement shared/terminal-stream-protocol.ts opcodes. Relay framing is13 bytes: one type byte, uint32BE id at1, ack at5, payload length at9. Relay protocol types Regular1, Handshake2, KeepAlive9; desktop main protocol lists Regular1/KeepAlive9. Framing accepts numeric types; dispatcher handles Regular and KeepAlive only after updating contact/highest-sequence metadata. Unknown types are not terminal-stream negotiation.

Regular payloads are JSON-RPC; parseJsonRpcMessage checks jsonrpc==='2.0', not a complete request/response schema. Handshake parsing validates its three recognized kind strings, not every envelope field. Separate daemon handshake checks exact launchVersion and optional endpoint credential. readLaunchVersion reads .version beside resolved entry path, falling back to RELAY_VERSION; no live authentication/version refusal test performed.

Shared decoder bounds payload16MiB, retained input16MiB+13+1MiB; per-turn64frames /16MiB+13bytes /4ms defaults with positive finite overrides. Oversize body discarded incrementally; retained-input overflow resets. Continuation exceptions reset and report typed error, unlike synchronous callback failures. Partial frames keep reads active. Generation/reset/drain cancel continuation ownership.

The mixed-runtime terminal-stream outputPause negotiation example belongs to a different protocol. Relay bundle/version lock and runtime semantic compatibility must not be merged or silently substituted.
